title: Prometheus plugin manifest
description: Schema for a .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest. Derived from the manifests actually shipped in this repo, not from an idealized spec: every property here appears in at least one real plugin.json. additionalProperties stays true because Claude Code and Codex both tolerate forward-compatible keys, and a plugin should not fail to load because it declares something a newer host understands.

$schema.description: Optional pointer back to this file.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier. Must match the marketplace entry that references this plugin.

displayName.description: Human-facing name. Falls back to `name` when absent.

description.description: What the plugin provides. Shown during plugin discovery, so the same trigger-wording guidance that applies to skill descriptions applies here: see docs/skill-authoring-guide.md.

version.description: Semver. Note that plugin versions in this repo have drifted from the pack version (pack 1.7.0 vs several plugins still at 1.5.x); reconcile on release.

author.description: Both the string and object forms appear in this repo; both are accepted.

skills.description: Skill directories this plugin contributes. Two forms ship in this repo and both are valid: an array of relative directory paths, or a single string path to a SKILL.md (used by single-skill plugins such as tools/openai-proxy). Paths use forward slashes only. Leading './' is conventional but not required -- skills/imported/prometheus-entity-management uses bare relative paths.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers this plugin registers. Either an inline map keyed by server name, or a string path to a .mcp.json file (the form used by iterative-evolver and openai-proxy).

compatibility.description: Host/runtime compatibility. Free-text in most manifests; prometheus-entity-skills uses a structured object instead. Both are accepted.

hooks.description: Path to a hooks manifest. NOTE: Claude Code auto-loads hooks/hooks.json from the plugin root, so declaring that same default path here makes plugin load fail with 'Duplicate hooks file detected'. Only set this for a non-default location. See CLAUDE.md.
